title: Rename billingUrl -> billingEndpoint in shared-contracts and 3 apps (mono, single PR)

summary: Renamed billingUrl->billingEndpoint (same value) in libs/shared-contracts and the 3 consuming apps (core-shell, billing, reports) in one mono PR #1; all apps built locally, CI+CD green. Assumptions: platform-kit has no reference to billingUrl so no republish/bump needed; shared-contracts is inlined at build time so no version bump.
